incidents.summary: The ASA banned a Utility Warehouse mobile advert because it did not make the fair-use restriction on its advertised unlimited data plan sufficiently clear.

sources.title: Utility Warehouse UK Mobile Ad Banned for Lack of Clarity on Unlimited Data Limits - ISPreview UK

sources.quote: But while the ASA didn’t have a problem with the 500GB figure, they did uphold the second complaint because the advert failed to express the restriction clearly enough.
